MC02-24M.object: Three-view and three-quarter concept of a walkable suspension bridge connecting two cliff boardwalk landings in a mountain city, span 24 m, deck 1.6 m wide and sag 1.5 m, made of fitted warm-grey stone bridgeheads, dark iron chains, weathered cedar planks and hemp lashings, with missing decorative planks outside the continuous safe walking surface, rain wear on the deck and moss in the stone seams; water: none. Show only this one bridge as a single game module: a granite bridgehead with two short stone posts at each end where the chains are anchored, two dark iron hand chains on each side hanging in a gentle catenary, short iron hangers down to two deck chains, a continuous deck of weathered cedar planks lashed with hemp (a few loose or missing decorative planks only at the outer edges, never in the walking path), the two ends at exactly the same height; Chinese Song-dynasty mountain city style; no buildings, no towers, no gates, no people, no lettering, no flags.
